title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E32 — Death at Dawn
A member of a powerful gang murders a shopkeeper; the deputized Cartwrights sentence a murderer to hang at dawn when the leader of the gang kidnaps Ben and holds him hostage.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E01 — Showdown
A young bank robber gets a job on the Ponderosa to prevent the sheriff from finding the other members of his gang.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E03 — Badge Without Honor
A Deputy U.S. Marshal arrives to escort a man to California to testify against a gang; guest Dan Duryea.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E04 — The Mill
Ben tries to help his paraplegic neighbor Tom by setting up a grain mill on his unused land; Tom's hired hand raises his suspicion about Ben's plan.

title: Yodelin' Kid From Pine Ridge
description: A singing cowboy rides to the rescue when a feud erupts between cattlemen and turpentine manufacturers.

title: Frontier Justice
description: A practical joker (Hoot Gibson) rescues his cattleman father from shady sheepmen.

title: Young Buffalo Bill
description: Buffalo Bill (Roy Rogers) and the cavalry protect mining surveyors from Indians in New Mexico.

title: Buffalo Stampede
description: Buffalo hide trader Tom Doan must track down and outsmart a gang of white thieves disguised as raiding American Indians to save the woman he loves.

title: Captain Apache
description: A full-blooded Apache working for the U.S. Army investigates a colleague's murder and uncovers a plot by a wealthy white farmer to instigate an Indian war; gunplay and bloodshed follow as the investigation deepens.

title: West of the Divide
description: Ted and Dusty infiltrate a band of outlaws to get close to Mr. Gentry, the man who murdered Ted's father.

title: The Legend of the Lone Ranger
description: When the Butch Cavendish gang ambushes a group of Texas Rangers, the only surviving ranger dons a mask to protect his identity and swears to bring them to justice.

title: Lost Canyon
description: After Johnny is accused of robbing a bank, he runs into the hills. When his friend Hopalong Cassidy hears what happened, Hopalong sets out to find the real bad guys.

title: The Kansan
description: The new marshal (Richard Dix) of a Kansas town cracks down on his sponsor, a greedy banker (Albert Dekker).

title: Bulldog Courage
description: A young man, out to avenge his father's murder, prompts speedy action from the law.

title: Roll, Thunder, Roll
description: Red Ryder (Jim Bannon) and Little Beaver (Don Kay Reynolds) help a Mexican Robin Hood framed by raiders.

title: Hit the Saddle
description: The Three Mesquiteers (Robert Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune) discover a painted horse and a fandango dancer.

title: Hellgate
description: After the Civil War, ranch owner Gil Hanley helps a stranger in desperate need of medical attention. Soon he is questioned by Union soldiers about the stranger, who turns out to be an ex-Confederate soldier.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E10 — The Will
A stage line driver is framed in the looting of strongboxes by the stage line owner and freighter.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E12 — Renegade Son
After a woman is wrongfully jailed, Cisco and Pancho plan to trap the real murderer.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E15 — Lynching Story
Cisco and Pancho prove that an office manager and his followers are murderers.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E16 — Newspaper Crusaders
A gambler's thugs beat up a crusading newspaperman.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E25 — Ben Thompson
Matt and Frankie look into Ben Thompson's background; Matt gets a job at a gambling den to obtain evidence about Ben's criminal activities.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E26 — Clay Allison
Matt arrests John Allison; Frankie's doctor is kidnapped; Clay falls into Matt's trap.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E01 — Belle Starr
Matt Clark and Frankie Adams pursue a female outlaw named Belle Starr after her gang steals a herd of horses from the U.S. cavalry.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E02 — Billy the Kid
Matt teams with Pat Garrett after a large herd of horses is stolen.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E10 — The Servant
Hawkeye and Chingachgook find a young Irish girl, Bridget, alone in the woods; she is running away from a man named Stark who claims to own her.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E11 — The Search
Hawkeye and Chingachgook rescue an elderly woman from two Indians who have kidnapped her and were about to take her back to their tribe.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E12 — Snake Tattoo
Hawkeye and Chingachgook set out to help a young Indian boy who has been raised by a white man, but they soon discover that the boy is the long-lost son of a Cree tribal chief.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E13 — False Witness
Army payroll messengers are found dead, murdered by a gang of bandits, and the payroll stolen; in order to find the killers, Hawkeye and Chingachgook go undercover as managers of a local trading post.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E14 — Powder Keg
Fur trader McKenzie initiates a war between the Hurons and the nearby settlement where another trader is taking his business.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E40 — Scapegoat
After a long winter, the Tuscarora tribe struggles for survival; Hawkeye and Chingachgook set out to help. Starring John Hart as Hawkeye, and Lon Chaney Jr as Chingachgook.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E16 — Way Station
The daughter of Mingo Chief Nocona is desired by two warring tribesmen.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E17 — The Brute
Needed winter supplies are being stolen before they can reach the village; Tim, a simple-minded man, is made to believe he killed someone and when he flees he becomes an easy scapegoat.

title: Bells of San Angelo
description: A writer (Dale Evans) of cowboy novels saves herself and a border agent (Roy Rogers) with a trick from her latest book.

title: Home in Oklahoma
description: A singing newsman (Roy Rogers), a ranch foreman (George "Gabby" Hayes) and a newswoman (Dale Evans) team up to track killers.

title: The Way of the West
description: A Mountie moves to a town and begins to stop its illegal activity by busting people one by one.

title: Mohawk
description: A barmaid, a Bostonian and an Indian (Rita Gam) flirt with an artist (Scott Brady) in 18th-century upstate New York.

title: McLintock!
description: A cattle baron (John Wayne) tries to tame his wife (Maureen O'Hara) amid a feud with settlers and trouble with Indians.

title: Vengeance Valley
description: A rancher's son (Robert Walker) gets his foster brother (Burt Lancaster) in trouble with an unwed mother's brothers.

title: Riders of the Whistling Skull
description: The Three Mesquiteers (Bob Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune) join a spooky search for a lost city of riches.

title: Idaho
description: A state ranger (Roy Rogers) clears a crusading judge framed for a bank robbery.

title: Brothers of the West
description: Detective Tom Wade (Tom Tyler) has to investigate the truth behind a robbery and murder of a bank president that's being blamed on Tom's brother, Ed (Bob Terry), who is nowhere to be found.

title: The Fighting Redhead
description: Red Ryder helps his old friend Dan O'Connor in his fight against Faro Savage and his gang of rustlers.

title: Rawhide Rangers
description: An ex-lawman infiltrates an outlaw gang to avenge the death of his brother.

title: Springtime in the Sierras
description: A gang of poachers must be stopped as they kill and sell game out of season. Roy figures out who the culprits are and goes undercover to investigate further.

title: My Pal Trigger
description: Roy's horse-breeding plans are complicated by a gambler in this fictional account of Trigger's conception and birth.

title: Boots and Saddles
description: A singing ranch foreman and his sidekick convince a young British nobleman to keep, rather than sell, the ranch left to him by his late father.

title: Arizona Bound
description: The Rough Riders (Buck Jones, Tim McCoy, Raymond Hatton) team up to save a woman's stagecoach line from a Mesa City saloon gang.

title: Wildfire
description: Two horse-traders (Bob Steele, Sterling Holloway) find their problem is a rustler (John Miljan), not a wild horse.

title: Robin Hood of the Pecos
description: A night rider (George "Gabby" Hayes) and his singing partner (Roy Rogers) send Texas carpetbaggers packing.

title: The Hanged Man
description: A former gunslinger survives his own hanging and transforms himself into a mysterious avenger of injustice.

title: Tulsa
description: A cattle rancher's daughter (Susan Hayward) turns Oklahoma wildcatter with a geologist (Robert Preston) and an Indian (Pedro Armendáriz) as partners.

title: Under California Stars
description: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers.

title: The Cowboy and the Prizefighter
description: Red Ryder KO's a fight racket with sidekick Little Beaver and a new friend.

title: Hell Town
description: A rancher (John Mack Brown) makes his cousin (John Wayne) trail boss on a cattle drive headed for trouble.

title: In Old Colorado
description: Hopalong Cassidy stops Joe Weiler from instigating a prairie war between two ranchers.

title: Hoppy Serves a Writ
description: Hopalong Cassidy and his sidekicks lure outlaws out of Oklahoma to justice in Texas.

title: The Light of Western Stars
description: A Boston socialite (Jo Ann Sayers) attracts a ruffian (Victor Jory) along the Mexican border circa 1915.

title: Riders of the Deadline
description: Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) and his pals (Andy Clyde, Jimmy Rogers) get the drop on Mexican-border gunrunners.

title: High Lonesome
description: Texas ranchers blame a homeless drifter (John Barrymore Jr.) for two killers' dirty work.

title: Born to Battle
description: Cattlemen offer a jailed cowboy his freedom if he will agree to help locate a gang of notorious rustlers.

title: The Gunman From Bodie
description: The Rough Riders (Buck Jones, Tim McCoy, Raymond Hatton) act like strangers to catch a crooked lawyer.

title: Gunsmoke Ranch
description: The Three Mesquiteers (Bob Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune) stop a land swindler out to profit from a flood.

title: Sitting Bull
description: President Grant helps a cavalry major (Dale Robertson) condemned for helping Dakota Chief Sitting Bull (J. Carrol Naish).

title: Song of Arizona
description: A youth from Gabby Whittaker's (George "Gabby" Hayes) Half-a-Chance Ranch for boys from troubled homes becomes a pawn in the fight between his late father's gang and Roy Rogers.

title: Hands Across the Border
description: A singing cowboy (Roy Rogers) helps a slain rancher's daughter (Ruth Terry) breed horses for the Army.

title: Public Cowboy, No. 1
description: Modern-day cattle rustlers use a radio, airplanes and refrigerator trucks to expedite their illegal schemes.

title: Under Western Stars
description: A singing-cowboy congressman (Roy Rogers) goes to Washington to save ranchers from a power dam.

title: Grand Canyon Trail
description: Not long after ambitious prospector J. Malcolm Vanderpool takes an interest in the run-down remnants of a small frontier town, fortune seekers from all over rush to gain a silver mine of their own.

title: Colorado
description: Lieutenant Jerry Burke (Roy Rogers) is sent to Colorado to track down a troublesome gang. When he finally catches them, he finds out his traitorous brother commands them.

title: Daniel Boone, Trail Blazer
description: The frontiersman (Bruce Bennett) leads settlers to Kentucky, where he makes peace with a Shawnee chief (Lon Chaney).

title: Rawhide
description: A baseball star (Lou Gehrig) goes west with his sister (Evalyn Knapp) and helps a lawyer (Smith Ballew) bust a cattle-protection racket.

title: Yellowneck
description: A sergeant (Lin McCarthy), a colonel (Stephen Courtleigh), a thief (Berry Kroeger) and two other Rebel deserters trek toward Cuba through the Everglades.

title: The Lucky Texan
description: Jerry Mason (John Wayne) and his friend Jake (George Hayes) have to keep two crooks away from their gold.

title: Wagon Trail
description: Townsfolk turn against their sheriff (Harry Carey) because of his outlaw son (Edward Norris).

title: One-Eyed Jacks
description: An ex-convict bandit (Marlon Brando) finds the partner (Karl Malden) who betrayed him is now a town sheriff with a wife (Katy Jurado) and daughter.

title: The Deadly Companions
description: An ex-army officer accidentally kills a woman's son and tries to make up for it.
